purpose: Teach: 完売/手形/再販/増収/不問/別個/特産/海苔

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究発表の参加枠は完売したぞ
lines.en: Ren—the research presentation slots sold out.
lines.style: Direct but not sharp. Measured pace. A brief statement of fact delivered to someone who needs to know. Slight upward lilt at the end—waiting to see how he takes it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究先との手形取引も学習しました
lines.en: Yes. I've learned about the co-research partnership's bill-of-exchange transactions too.
lines.style: Careful, earnest. Slightly quick—eager to show he's absorbing everything. A small pause before the second sentence, like he's checking he understood correctly. Respectful but not servile.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、絶版論文の再販を提案しろ
lines.en: Ren—propose a reissue for out-of-print papers.
lines.style: Clear directive. Steady, no-nonsense tempo. Weight on the instruction itself. The tone of someone who expects this to be actionable, not negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の増収を学会発表で報告します
lines.en: Yes. I'll report the increase in research funding at the academic conference.
lines.style: Assured but understated. Speaks from a place of already knowing what he'll do. Even rhythm. Not defensive—just confirming his understanding and next step.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、応募者の出身大学は不問だ
lines.en: Ren—the applicant's university of origin doesn't matter.
lines.style: Purposeful. Lands on 'doesn't matter' with quiet weight. A reassurance disguised as an order. Slightly slower, letting the message settle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文と特許出願は別個の手続きで進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll proceed with the paper and patent application through separate procedures.
lines.style: Methodical, precise. Speaks like someone already thinking through the logistics. Steady pace, no hesitation. Shows he's internalized the distinction being drawn.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、地域特産品の研究にも参加しろ
lines.en: Ren—contribute to the regional specialty product research as well.
lines.style: Another task, delivered with the same weight as the others. Matter-of-fact expansion of scope. Expects him to handle it. No softening—this is the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海苔の養殖技術を学会論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I've already covered nori cultivation techniques in an academic paper.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Steady, factual. The slight emphasis on 'already' suggests he's been thinking ahead. Closes with gentle finality—not done yet, but prepared.
